high.title: Pertamax Prices Rise Again - Minister Bahlil's Response
high.summary: Non-subsidized fuel prices Pertamax (RON 92) increased from Rp 12,300/liter to Rp 16,250/liter, and Pertamax Green (RON 95) from Rp 12,900/liter to Rp 17,000/liter. Energy Minister Bahlil stated these prices adjust to market conditions while guaranteeing no increases for subsidized fuels Pertalite and Biosolar.

high.title: Government Held Back Pertamax Price Increases for Months
high.summary: Government confirms the increase in non-subsidized fuel prices follows global oil prices, which have risen dramatically since March. The government had been restraining price increases for months while neighboring countries raised their fuel prices.

high.title: Free Nutrition Program Wastes Rp 1 Trillion Monthly - Government Opens Option to Close Kitchens
high.summary: The Free Nutritious Meals program has ballooned from planned 21,000 kitchen points to 27,877 points, causing Rp 1 trillion monthly waste. Food Coordinating Minister Zulkifli Hasan revealed trading of kitchen points and considers restructuring the program.

high.title: Danantara to Cut SOEs from 1,077 to 200 Companies
high.summary: Investment management body Danantara will drastically reduce state-owned enterprises from 1,077 to 200-300 entities this year. 52% of current SOEs are loss-making with accumulated losses of Rp 20 trillion, and the streamlining could save up to Rp 50 trillion annually.

high.title: IHSG Rises 2% as 615 Stocks Strengthen
high.summary: Indonesia's main stock index IHSG closed 2.07% higher at 6,007.65 points with strong market participation. Trading volume reached 36.91 billion shares with transaction value of Rp 21.57 trillion, showing robust investor interest.

high.title: SpaceX Records Largest IPO in History, Raises Rp 1,339 Trillion
high.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX debuted on Nasdaq at $150 per share, raising $75 billion in the largest IPO ever recorded. The stock peaked at $176.52 with over 500 million shares traded on the first day, approaching Facebook's 2012 debut record.

medium.title: Tax Officials Seize 3 Luxury Apartments in Jakarta Worth Over Rp 1 Billion
medium.summary: Tax authorities seized three luxury apartments in Kelapa Gading, North Jakarta, valued at over Rp 1 billion from a steel industry taxpayer. The seizure followed failed persuasive collection efforts and represents legal enforcement under tax collection laws.

medium.title: Indonesia Has First Radioactive Testing Lab for Fishery Products in Southeast Asia
medium.summary: Indonesia established its first radioactive contamination testing laboratory for fishery products in Cipayung, East Jakarta. The facility is ISO 17025 accredited and FDA-approved to test parameters including Cs-137, supporting seafood export competitiveness particularly to the US market.

medium.title: Marine Minister Proposes Additional Rp 30 Trillion Budget for 600 Fishing Villages
medium.summary: Marine and Fisheries Minister Sakti Wahyu Trenggono requested additional Rp 30 trillion budget for 2027, on top of the indicative budget of Rp 15.63 trillion. The funds will support blue economy implementation and priority national programs.

medium.title: TIMAH Restructures Board of Directors, Eliminates Deputy CEO Position
medium.summary: State tin miner PT TIMAH restructured its board during the 2025 annual shareholders meeting, eliminating the Deputy CEO position and creating new director roles. Former Deputy CEO Harry Budi Sidharta was appointed as Director of Corporate Strategy and Business Development.

medium.title: TIMAH Records Rp 1.3 Trillion Profit, Distributes Rp 656 Billion Dividend
medium.summary: State tin miner PT TIMAH distributed Rp 656.8 billion in dividends, equivalent to 50% of its net profit of Rp 1.31 trillion. The company recorded revenue growth of 6.41% to Rp 11.55 trillion with operating profit of Rp 1.91 trillion.

medium.title: Three Convicted in Tax Manipulation and Money Laundering Case
medium.summary: East Jakarta District Court sentenced three defendants in tax manipulation and money laundering case through PT GTS. The sentences range from 2 years 8 months to 3 years 4 months prison, plus fines totaling over Rp 6 billion combined.

medium.title: Antam Gold Prices Rise Slightly Today
medium.summary: Antam 24-karat gold prices increased Rp 2,000 per gram to Rp 2,711,000 per gram after recent weakness. Gold prices have been declining over the past week and month, trading in ranges of Rp 2,689,000-2,759,000 and Rp 2,689,000-2,819,000 respectively.

medium.title: Export Governance of Coal and CPO Through DSI to Strengthen Indonesian Economy
medium.summary: Research institute PEDAS notes that strategic export governance of coal, CPO, and ferroalloy commodities worth over $66 billion annually will strengthen national economy. These commodities represent about a quarter of total national exports, showing the strategic importance of government policy.

medium.title: Trade Ministry Issues 3 Regulations for Natural Resources Export via DSI
medium.summary: Trade Ministry published three ministerial regulations governing strategic natural resources exports through PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI). The regulations cover coal, palm oil, and ferro alloy exports with transition period from June 1 to December 31, 2026.

medium.title: Bakrie Brothers Records Rp 503 Billion Profit
medium.summary: PT Bakrie & Brothers posted 49.6% increase in net profit to Rp 503 billion in 2025, up Rp 167 billion from previous year. Despite geopolitical tensions and market volatility, the company achieved positive performance with net revenue of Rp 3.74 trillion.

medium.title: Phapros Records Rp 27 Million Profit, Distributes 15% Dividend
medium.summary: Pharmaceutical company PT Phapros distributed cash dividend of 15% from 2025 net profit as approved in annual shareholders meeting. Remaining profits will be used as reserves for capital expenditure to meet company compliance requirements.
